theme.description: Premium Red + Gold + Black on crisp Warm Alabaster/White base. Reflects financial trust, wealth acceleration, and high-conversion affiliate empowerment for Radhika Traders.

typography.font_family_headings: Cabinet Grotesk / Clash Display / Outfit, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans / IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro, monospace

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-950
scale.caption: text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-500

layout_and_grids.header_nav: Sticky glassmorphism banner with high optical clarity (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-200/80), z-50 with responsive desktop menu and mobile drawer. Includes logo, quick links, live ticker ribbon, wallet pill, and CTA.
layout_and_grids.ticker_ribbon: High-impact gold & dark-slate micro-ticker on top of landing showcasing live affiliate earnings ('Rahul earned ₹1,200 on Demat campaign', 'New HDFC Credit Card campaign added').
layout_and_grids.tetris_bento_grid: For landing & showcase: 12-column grid layout with asymmetric spans (col-span-8 for top earning campaign highlight, col-span-4 for quick payout card, col-span-4 for instant referral link generator).
layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Dense 4-column KPI overview (Total Earnings, Active Referrals, Available Wallet Balance, Pending Withdrawals) followed by interactive payout velocity charts and campaign offer table.
layout_and_grids.mobile_first_design: Card elements use compact touch targets with tap-to-copy referral link, instant WhatsApp/Telegram trigger buttons, and swipeable tab navigation.

hero_financial_advisor.alt: Radhika Traders executive financial advisory meeting in modern office

credit_card_technology.alt: Instant digital credit card and fintech reward activation

stock_market_trading.alt: Live trading charts and Demat account high payout campaigns

business_consultation.alt: Harish Bhati and core advisory team reviewing strategic campaigns

card_payment_pos.alt: Premium metal banking card and instant cashback offers

key_components.BrandHeader: Sticky navigation with Radhika Traders luxury crest/badge logo, navigation links, campaign category dropdown, customer wallet badge, login/signup/dashboard trigger.
key_components.LiveCampaignCard: Rich interactive card with company logo, offer type badge, live payout tag (₹300 - ₹2500 per lead), requirement pills, key benefits preview, 1-click share to WhatsApp/Telegram, and 'Get Referral Link' action.
key_components.CampaignDetailModalOrPage: Comprehensive breakdown containing Banner header, Payout terms, Step-by-step conversion rules, target audience criteria, personalized referral link builder, QR code generator, and instant share buttons.
key_components.CustomerWalletDashboard: Interactive wallet balance card (Available, In-Review, Lifetime Earnings), Withdrawal request form with Bank/UPI details, Real-time status tracker, and CSV/Excel/PDF statement exporter.
key_components.AdminCampaignManager: Admin control center for CRUD operations on campaigns (Upload banner URL, set payout, title, rules, category: Demat, Savings, Credit Card, Insurance, Loan, Digital Marketing, change status LIVE/PAUSED/CLOSED), view customer list, approve/reject withdrawals, and review analytics.
key_components.KYCVerificationCard: Profile and KYC verification system with PAN/Aadhaar/Bank detail input, status indicator (Verified/Pending/Not Submitted), and security badges.

visual_enhancers.gold_borders: 1px solid rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.25) with subtle gold box-shadow on active cards
visual_enhancers.glass_stat_cards: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
visual_enhancers.live_indicators: Pulsing green ring on LIVE campaigns to convey real-time freshness
visual_enhancers.gradient_buttons: Primary CTA with `bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 via-red-700 to-red-800 text-white font-semibold shadow-sm hover:from-red-700 hover:to-red-900 active:scale-[0.98]`
visual_enhancers.gold_badges: bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 border border-amber-300/40 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files throughout the frontend application as configured.
Ensure the branding 'RADHIKA TRADERS · Trusted Partner for Financial Growth' (Founder: Harish Bhati) is prominently featured on Landing, Header, About Us, and Footer.

Provide a preloaded set of realistic Indian financial campaigns across categories: Demat (AngelOne, Zerodha, Upstox), Savings A/C (AU Small Finance Bank, Kotak 811, IndusInd), Credit Cards (HDFC Tata Neu, SBI SimplyCLICK, Axis Neo), Insurance & Loans with clear ₹ payouts (e.g. ₹450 to ₹2200).

Implement real working client-side or fullstack logic with FastAPI backend: campaign listing with filters & search, referral link generation with user ID, customer wallet balance computation, mock/real OTP login modal, withdrawal request workflow, statement PDF/CSV export simulation.

Every key interactive element, button, tab, search input, card, and modal trigger must have a unique `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid='campaign-card-angelone'`, `data-testid='wallet-withdraw-btn'`, `data-testid='filter-category-demat'`).
Ensure high contrast: text must always remain readable, never use pure transparent dropdown or modal backgrounds.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not center-align the whole app. Avoid generic blue gradients. Use the defined Crimson Red + Warm Amber Gold + Obsidian Black color scheme on clean alabaster surfaces.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessibility: Ensure all text on red or gold badges meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast standards. Use high-contrast hover states.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.smooth_transitions: Animate tabs, filter switches, and modal opens with crisp 150-200ms ease-out transitions. Never use universal `transition: all`.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for live feedback on copy referral link, withdrawal submitted, campaign created, and login.
